roles.title: Managing Director
responsibilities: Leads the company and the management team in Bengaluru.

roles.title: Head of Sales
responsibilities: Leads the sales team, signs statements of work with clients and approves the team's travel claims.

roles.title: Account Manager
responsibilities: Visits clients, prepares proposals, collects signed statements of work and submits travel claims.

roles.title: Head of Delivery
responsibilities: Runs all client projects, assigns Project Managers and approves the department's purchases.

roles.title: Project Manager
responsibilities: Runs a client project day to day and raises purchase requests.

roles.title: HR Manager
responsibilities: Owns hiring, employee policies and the onboarding of new employees.

roles.title: HR Executive
responsibilities: Handles offer letters, joining formalities and employee records.

roles.title: Administration Manager
responsibilities: Runs the office, IT and vendor purchasing, and issues purchase orders.

roles.title: IT Executive
responsibilities: Sets up laptops, email accounts and access cards, and collects vendor quotations.

roles.title: Finance Controller
responsibilities: Owns budgets, payments, payroll and the company's accounts.

roles.title: Accounts Executive
responsibilities: Raises GST invoices to clients, pays vendors and processes reimbursements.

relationships.description: Approved purchase requests are sent to IT & Administration to obtain quotations and issue purchase orders.

evidence.quote: Approved purchase requests are sent to IT & Administration.

relationships.description: IT & Administration forwards each vendor's GST invoice to Finance for payment processing.

evidence.quote: IT & Administration forwards each vendor's GST invoice to Finance.

relationships.description: Approved travel and expense claims are sent to Finance for reimbursement.

evidence.quote: Approved claims are sent to Finance.

relationships.description: HR Executive sends new joiner requests to IT & Administration to set up equipment and access.

evidence.quote: When a candidate accepts an offer, the HR Executive sends a new joiner request to IT & Administration at least five working days before the joining date

relationships.description: IT confirms setup of laptop, email account, and access card to HR before the joining date.

evidence.quote: The IT Executive sets up the laptop, the email account and the access card, and confirms to HR the day before the joining date.

relationships.description: HR sends joining details to Finance to add new employees to payroll.

evidence.quote: On the joining date, HR sends the joining details to Finance: the employee's bank account, PAN and monthly salary.

relationships.description: Account Manager sends signed statements of work to Delivery to initiate projects.

evidence.quote: When a client signs a statement of work, the Account Manager sends it to Delivery with the scope, the milestones and the agreed rates.

relationships.description: Project Manager sends signed milestone acceptance to Finance for invoicing.

evidence.quote: When the client accepts a milestone, the Project Manager sends the signed milestone acceptance to Finance.
